summary: Saudi Energy Q2 2026 EPS of $0.753 beat estimates by 31.69%; H1 revenue rose 10.5% YoY to SAR 52.2B, net profit up 7.5% to SAR 6.7B.
Company maintained FY 2026 capex guidance of SAR 70-75B, expects elevated spending through 2027 before declining toward 2028-2030.
Regulated asset base grew 14.1% YoY to SAR 278.7B; management expects new regulatory WACC for 2027-2029 to be set before year-end 2026.
Stock traded at $17.08, up 0.47%, near top of 52-week range; InvestingPro analysis suggests undervaluation at P/E of 10.25.
CEO highlighted zero outages during record Hajj demand; CFO said higher debt costs will be offset through regulated WACC resets.
